notes: The ASV writes could not as two words, so rule 2 splits them: lo takes only not and yakhol takes the subject pronoun and the modal (rule 35).
The li before the infinitive is unrepresented because the modal's bare complement writes no infinitive marker (rule 52's closing sentence).
ben of the age formula takes the was ... old with the construction-supplied copula, discontinuous around the numeral phrase (rules 20 and 25).
